## Checklist
- [ ] Every new or changed quote's exact wording was read at its `source` URL (or is honestly labelled `probable` / `unverified` / `disputed` / `misattributed`)
- [ ] No fabricated or "fixed" wording, citations, dates or attributions; translations are public domain, credited, or labelled AI-assisted
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` passes
- [ ] `python3 build.py` run and regenerated files committed (`git status` clean afterwards)
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` prints OK
- [ ] No new maxims, scoring-constant changes, `derives_from` links or cross-tradition `expresses` links, **or** they are listed below for owner approval
- [ ] No personal names, accounts or emails of maintainers added
- [ ] Change to The 42 (order or membership) noted below, or none
